'''SirPrissytheProtocolDroid Help Me Rescue My Rescue The Princess Deck!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SirPrissytheProtocolDroid]]
* '''Published:''' 7 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]] (inferred from the title)

== Introduction ==

I've been out of the SWCCG universe for years now, before virtual cards and shields and the like, and while looking over the virtual sets I saw that the objective RtP was much more feasible.  A few cards in this deck are pure randomness, as I simply c…

The deck page itself was not captured by the Wayback Machine, so only the listing-page entry (title, author, date and blurb) survives; the card list is lost.


== Notes ==

* Listing-only entry: the GPN listing page 2 records this deck, but the deck page itself was never captured by the Wayback Machine (checked 11 October 2026), so the card list is lost. The side is inferred from the published title.
